Fix the currency rounding bug in `ledgerly/money.py` where JPY amounts get two decimal places.

Refactored shared billing CLI filters, added abbreviation coverage, and confirmed abbreviated `--curr`/`--sta` parsing. The newest regression test was added but not yet run.
